I can draft this, but I can’t responsibly turn these notes into a public post with the technical claims as written. The dates don’t line up: October 28, 2026 is a Wednesday, but “last week” relative to November 10 would be November 2–8. The electrical numbers also need checking: at 12V, 1,800–2,000W is roughly 150–167A before inverter losses, not automatically 150–250A; actual current depends on voltage and efficiency. Cable and fuse requirements depend on the installation details, so I wouldn’t present “2/0,” “within 18cm,” or the proposed Class T fuse as universal rules without confirming them with Priya or another qualified professional.

Could you confirm the incident date and ask Priya to verify the current draw, cable/fuse guidance, and what can safely be stated about the failed lug? I can then shape the post around what you personally saw, what Priya found, and a cautious, power-off checklist that tells readers when to stop and call a pro.
